title: Get Presale Tickets to John Mayer’s Just-Announced 2027 Sphere Shows
summary: SiriusXM listeners can get early access to tickets for the seven-time GRAMMY winner's upcoming Sphere shows in Vegas.
body_markdown:
[John Mayer](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/john-mayer) has added three more dates to his 2027 Sphere residency in Las Vegas, expanding the run to 21 shows from April through June — and SiriusXM listeners will have a chance to get tickets to the newly announced shows before they go on sale to the general public.


The new shows will take place June 9, 11, and 12.


[Life with John Mayer The ever-changing playlist Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogJohnMayerPresaleLWJM)


### **How to Get Presale Tickets**


The SiriusXM presale for John Mayer’s newly added June 9, 11, and 12 shows starts Thursday, October 15, at 10am PT, giving listeners an opportunity to purchase tickets ahead of the general public.


Tune in to SiriusXM’s Life with[John Mayer (Ch. 4)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/life-with-john-mayer) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogJohnMayerPresaleLWJM) for information about how to access the presale.


The general public on-sale for the newly added shows begins Friday, October 16, at 10am PT.


### **John Mayer Live at Sphere Dates**


John Mayer will perform at Sphere on:


- Thursday, April 8, 2027
- Saturday, April 10, 2027
- Sunday, April 11, 2027
- Thursday, April 15, 2027
- Saturday, April 17, 2027
- Sunday, April 18, 2027
- Wednesday, April 28, 2027
- Friday, April 30, 2027
- Saturday, May 1, 2027
- Wednesday, May 5, 2027
- Friday, May 7, 2027
- Saturday, May 8, 2027
- Wednesday, May 12, 2027
- Friday, May 14, 2027
- Saturday, May 15, 2027
- Wednesday, June 2, 2027
- Friday, June 4, 2027
- Saturday, June 5, 2027
- **Wednesday, June 9, 2027**
- **Friday, June 11, 2027**
- **Saturday, June 12, 2027**


Each show will feature John’s music in three different forms: solo, full band, and the John Mayer Trio.


For the solo portion, John will perform alone onstage, with an emphasis on acoustic guitar as well as performances on piano and electric guitar. The John Mayer Trio — John, Steve Jordan, and Pino Palladino — will also reunite in concert for the first time since 2017.


### **Life with John Mayer on SiriusXM**


Launched in 2023, Life with John Mayer (Ch. 4) is John’s exclusive, year-round SiriusXM channel, curated and presented by the seven-time GRAMMY Award winner.


The channel gives listeners a window into John’s musical world through songs he loves, personal stories, special programming, and music spanning his own career and influences.


Listen to Life with John Mayer on satellite channel 4 and the SiriusXM app all year round.
